skill.name: incident-responder
skill.description: Guides SRE incident assessment, command, investigation, recovery, communication, and post-incident improvement using modern observability practices.
skill.summary: Structure incident response from initial triage through recovery and post-incident review.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Service incidents require fast decisions, clear ownership, and reliable communication. This skill structures triage, investigation, recovery, validation, and post-incident learning.
actual_capabilities: Classifies incident severity using user, business, system, and regulatory impact.
Defines incident commander, communication lead, and technical lead responsibilities.
Structures investigations across metrics, traces, logs, dependencies, capacity, databases, and networks.
Plans stabilization, rollback, staged recovery, and service health validation.
Drafts stakeholder updates, incident timelines, postmortems, and improvement actions.
Applies SRE concepts including error budgets, burn rates, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and does not directly access monitoring, deployment, or incident management systems.
Recommendations require validation against local runbooks, permissions, compliance rules, and production conditions.
Severity targets and response timelines must be adapted to organizational policies.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Lead an Active Outage
use_cases.description: Create a prioritized response plan, assign roles, assess impact, and establish update intervals.

use_cases.title: Investigate Service Degradation
use_cases.description: Correlate recent changes with metrics, traces, logs, dependencies, capacity, and user impact.

use_cases.title: Run a Post-Incident Review
use_cases.description: Build a blameless timeline, analyze contributing factors, and define measurable prevention and detection improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Classify an Incident
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify this incident using user impact, business impact, affected systems, and external factors: [incident details]. State assumptions and missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a newly reported incident

prompt_templates.title: Create a Response Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a first-30-minute response plan for [incident]. Assign roles, prioritize stabilization, define validation checks, and draft internal and customer updates.

prompt_templates.title: Guide an Observability Investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these symptoms and telemetry: [details]. Propose ranked hypotheses and checks across changes, metrics, traces, logs, dependencies, capacity, databases, and networks.

prompt_templates.title: Design Recovery and Follow-Up
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this incident timeline and evidence: [details], propose a staged recovery plan, rollback criteria, validation gates, contributing factors, and measurable follow-up actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced recovery planning and post-incident analysis

output_examples.input: Checkout errors rose from one percent to forty percent after a payment service deployment.
output: Severity: P1 because a major customer journey is degraded.
Stabilization: pause the deployment and assess rollback readiness.
Validation: monitor checkout success, latency, payment dependency health, and regional impact.
Communication: post an initial status update and report progress hourly.

output_examples.input: Prepare a post-incident review for a retry storm that exhausted database connections.
output: Timeline: capture the triggering failure, retry growth, connection saturation, mitigation, and recovery.
Contributing factors: unlimited retries, weak connection alerts, and insufficient capacity protection.
Actions: add exponential backoff, retry budgets, connection saturation alerts, and a resilience test.

best_practices: Prioritize service restoration while preserving evidence and rollback options.
Use current telemetry to test ranked hypotheses and record every important decision.
Communicate on a fixed schedule with detail appropriate for each audience.
anti_patterns: Do not make high-risk production changes without ownership, validation, and rollback criteria.
Do not delay stakeholder updates until the root cause is known.
Do not treat a temporary symptom reduction as confirmed recovery.

faq.question: Can this skill operate monitoring or deployment tools?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured guidance based on information supplied by the user.

faq.question: Which incidents does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports service outages, degraded performance, dependency failures, capacity problems, and related reliability events.

faq.question: Does it replace an organizational incident runbook?
faq.answer: No. Local runbooks, escalation policies, compliance requirements, and authority boundaries remain controlling.

faq.question: Can it help classify severity?
faq.answer: Yes. It considers user impact, business impact, system scope, and external factors.

faq.question: Can it prepare customer communications?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft clear status updates, but authorized staff must review and publish them.

faq.question: Can it support post-incident work?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure timelines, contributing factors, root cause analysis, action items, and follow-up measures.
